page_title: louppe media culler | free photo, video & audio sorter for mac

sources.entry: Louppe - Photo and video viewer and sorter for browsing JPEG, RAW, and video folders, choosing keepers with the keyboard, and copying them without a library import. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/murlexander/louppe-media-culler) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon] [![App Store][app-store Icon]](https://apps.apple.com/app/louppe/id6820131477)

summary.name: louppe media culler
summary.one_liner: A free, open-source Mac app for culling photos and video by reviewing folders, marking keepers and rejects, and copying the keepers without importing into a library.
use_cases: culling a photo shoot to pick keepers
reviewing RAW and JPEG pairs from a memory card
checking focus at 100% before keeping shots
copying selected keepers to a new folder
finding duplicates and bursts in an archive
summary.what_it_does: Louppe opens a folder, external drive, or memory card and shows photos one at a time in Gallery, or as a contact sheet in Grid. Users mark each item yes or no with keyboard keys, with stars and color labels as separate decisions, and can filter to see only keepers. Export copies keepers (keeping RAW+JPEG pairs together) or writes XMP for an editor, and originals stay at the source. It can also play video and audio, show focus at 100%, histogram and clipping, and flag high ISO or slow shutter speeds.
notable: Works without importing into a catalog or library; open folders as they are
Open source under MIT license, with no account or app analytics
Marking no never deletes; Clean Up to Trash is a separate step
Keyboard-driven with VoiceOver support and customizable keys
caveats: Requires Apple silicon and macOS 14 or later
Mac-only; no Windows or Linux version listed
Does not offer editing, maps, or synced two-photo comparison
